title: VTA Attestation — Mnemonic Status — payload
description: An empty request. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTA Attestation — Mnemonic Status — response payload
Response.description: The mnemonic export guard's current state. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/attestation/mnemonic-status/0.1#response.

windowActive.description: Whether the export window is currently open.

alreadyExported.description: Whether the mnemonic has already been exported. Once true, no further export succeeds — the release is one-time.

entropyAvailable.description: Whether the guard still holds entropy. False on every boot after the first, since a VTA generates its seed only once.

windowRemainingSecs.description: Seconds remaining in the export window; 0 once it has expired or was never active.
